'''Ubusuna Shrine''' (産土神社, Ubusuna Jinja).

* {{ill|Ubusuna Shrine (Konohana, Osaka)|ja|産土神社 (大阪市此花区)|qid=Q11574978}} - Located in [[Konohana Ward]], [[:en:Osaka City|Osaka City]], {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|en|Osaka Prefecture|qid=Q122723|lt=Osaka Prefecture}}. [[Modern system of Ranked Shinto shrines|Former shrine Rank]]: Village shrine.
* {{ill|Ubusuna Shrine (Taisho, Osaka)|ja|産土神社 (大阪市大正区)}} - Located in [[Taisho Ward]], Osaka City, Osaka Prefecture. Former shrine Rank: Village shrine.
* {{ill|Ubusuna Shrine (Hirano, Osaka)|ja|産土神社 (大阪市平野区)}} - Located in [[Nagayoshi Deto]], [[Hirano Ward]], Osaka City. Managed by [[Shiki Nagayoshi Shrines]]<ref>[http://www.shikinagayoshi-jinjya.org/kenmusya.html Shiki Nagayoshi Shrine], [http://www.jalan.net/travel-journal/000047446/], [http://mawarisute.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-182.html]</ref>.
* {{ill|Ubusuna Shrine (Higashi-Osaka)|ja|産土神社 (東大阪市)}} - Located in [[Higashi-Osaka City]], Osaka Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ubusuna Shrine (Misaki)|ja|産土神社 (岬町)}} - Located in [[Misaki Town]], [[:en:Sennan District|Sennan District]], Osaka Prefecture. Former shrine Rank: Village shrine.

* {{ill|Kokawa Ubusuna Shrine|ja|粉河産土神社|qid=Q106852508}} - Located in [[:en:Kokawa|Kokawa]], [[Kinokawa City]], {{ill|Wakayama Prefecture|en|Wakayama Prefecture|qid=Q131314|lt=Wakayama Prefecture}}. A subordinate and tutelary shrine of [[Kokawa-dera]].<ref>[http://www.wakayama-jinjacho.or.jp/jdb/sys/user/GetWjtTbl.php?JinjyaNo=3010 Kokawa Ubusuna Shrine]</ref>
